1.mascotDialogue: Balance factor is just left-height minus right-height, beta, simple subtraction. Anything outside [-1, 1] and — bas, rotation happens right away before we move on. That is the entire self-balancing trick.

2.mascotDialogue: `rotateRight` lifts the left child up to become the new root of this little subtree, and hands its old right child down to the node that just got demoted — three pointer swaps, beta, one single operation.

3.mascotDialogue: After the rotation, 20 sits right on top, balance factor 0 on both sides — beautiful symmetry! Without it, beta, 30 would have had a balance factor of 2 — a straight leaning line, not a tree anymore at all.

4.mascotDialogue: The balance factor badge on node 30 — that is the tell, beta! 2 is a hard violation, shown right there plainly, you don't even have to calculate it by hand to notice.
